assumptions.coverage: Area loading is the sum of projected organism areas over all heights divided by the Moon's area: four levels averaging 5% each make 0.20. The loadings are occupancy scenarios, with no cover selected.
assumptions.optics: Independent opaque projected footprints in a vertical-beam Poisson column: intercepted fraction F = h(1 - exp(-C/h)), mean light on a footprint F/C. Motion and diffuse redistribution let the mean dose stand for a body's annual budget. Height adds no solar budget of its own. The inherited surface canopy includes diffuse light; angular transport through the organisms, their reflectance and injury from long shadows are open. The complete local loss beneath footprints is the severe surface case.
assumptions.physiology: The reference gross fixation of 2 kg C/m2/year, light tissue, low maintenance, night suppression, photolytic gas and structure are the inherited engineered traits; the 5 kg C/m2/year case of the organism study is a separate physiological scenario.
assumptions.production: Renewed host tissue, replacement of dead adults and the existing sugar export; consumers' biomass spends this carbon. Unallocated assimilate stays separate, and allocating half of it to tissue is a sensitivity that needs its own structural and nutrient accounts.
assumptions.tissue_yield: 0.45/0.556 carbon retained per unit of construction assimilate, the construction assumption of the aerophyte biology and the sky-ecology food web.
assumptions.surface: Two surface responses: the light reduction spread over the habitat's budgets, or complete loss of surface production beneath the intercepted area. Both carry the rain channel. Habitat fraction 0.71 holds a representative share of surface production as a sensitivity on mapped geography still to come.
assumptions.rain: The rain-fed land's water falls in proportion to the sunlight kept from the surface, at the GCM gas-dimming branch's rain-fed growth loss per percent of dimming on the 0.950 design case. Absorption aloft probably cuts rain more than the same surface dimming; reflection moves the planet's energy balance instead, which needs a GCM run.
assumptions.sky_rules: Reef passes per town and beam switches per receiver scale linearly with cover from the domain synthesis's and the power screen's 1% basis, with reefs half the cover as in the class mixture.
assumptions.water: The existing per-area water requirements times total organism area: throughput through the organisms, returned to the air by transpiration. Each layer's share of the same rain, and the timing and route of resupply, are open.
assumptions.phosphorus: The mature mixture's forest-floor losses before atmospheric resupply, scaled by organism area, beside an ideal geometric interception of the shared Earth-analogue fallout counted once. The phosphorus envelope keeps its inherited hazards of 0.001-0.005 a year and its trait and harvest ranges; the carbon uses 0.003. Upward biological or managed return is an additional route.
assumptions.microbes: Optical-depth-constrained dry spherical particles with prescribed division and favourable duty: an optical and physiological requirement screen. Gross cell synthesis includes replacement; removal and mortality set persistence. Heterotrophic growth recycles carbon.
assumptions.climate: The biomass comparison's midpoint provisional sunlight relative to its 0.950 reference enters as a light sensitivity. The 301 K vertical climate, the organisms' optical feedback, albedo and hydrology come with the design run.
